body:
I was able to find a better workaround using this. I'm unsure if this error is because of the nvidia driver or a godot issue. Either way I'm in business now. 

`__NV_PRIME_RENDER_OFFLOAD=1 __VK_LAYER_NV_optimus=NVIDIA_only __NV_PRIME_RENDER_OFFLOAD_PROVIDER=NVIDIA-G1 ./Godot`

To add some additional information, this also happens on v4.7.1.stable.official [a13da4feb], with a non-Wayland display server (Linux Mint Cinnamon X11).

Except in my case Godot defaulted to using GPU0 (Nvidia RTX5070), and I tried to run on GPU1 (Nvidia GTX1660). Interestingly, starting Godot with GPU2 (Intel integrated graphics) works fine. So it seems to be related to switching between Nvidia (or at least discrete) GPUs. The Godot errors are also slightly different, due to not using Wayland.

The same workaround worked for me as well, so thanks for that.

### System Information
Godot v4.7.1.stable - Linux Mint 22.3 (Zena) on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 - Intel(R) Core(TM) i3-7100 CPU @ 3.90GHz (4 threads) - 31.22 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)
